name: GD Proxy Helper
description: Routes Geometry Dash music/song downloads through a local caching+retrying proxy so they succeed on the first attempt. Level data stays direct (the game's own connection).

proxy-url.name: Proxy URL
proxy-url.description: Run tools/gdproxy.py (or start-proxy.bat) first, then put the proxy address here, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 . Leave empty to disable.

direct-hosts.name: Direct hosts (no proxy)
direct-hosts.description: Hosts that bypass the proxy and use the game's own connection. Keep the default (boomlings.com) - Cloudflare trusts the game client but blocks proxies.
